explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 108 named tracks and releases across Boomkat's September 15 recommended new-release window, current artist and label Bandcamp pages, Planet Mu's 2026 catalogue, and current criticism. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The canonical ledger, annotations, journey map, discussion and revisit queues, rejected and discovery histories, inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, map-order, receipt and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, listener authorization, triggered revisit or unfinished repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. Nine fresh exact-title leads remain; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.
The recurring-PARK evidence guard was applied: one track per release was retained, with exact-track prose or an exact artist-hosted listing for each lead.
Planned placements were compared with the previous five completed discovery runs. Recently evaluated boundaries were avoided, while incomplete requests remained excluded from musical evidence.
Generic preorders, prestige-only reissues, persistent identities and tracks supported only by genre labels were inspected but excluded.
Source descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No sonic or transition property was inferred. Neither listener-protected handoff was split.

Rank reflects evidence specificity, selection-lens relevance, canonical potential and information gain, not novelty, orthodoxy, diversity, technical cleverness, artist prestige or a fixed chapter map.
